messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Gibbs <laura.gibbs@oakmontfinancial.com>, Steve Lang <steve.lang@oakmontfinancial.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Oakmont MAP: security intake & evidence sprint (draft)

Hi Laura / Steve — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (attached) focused on the security/SOC 2 milestone we discussed. This is intentionally conservative; we can tighten dates if your IT availability allows.

High-level MAP milestones (security/SOC 2 track):
- Ben (Redwood) — SOC 2 questionnaire v1 shared: due 2026-11-24 (attachment: Oakmont_SOC2_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx)
- Oakmont IT — Questionnaire complete & initial answers: target 2026-12-08 (owner: Oakmont IT / Laura)
- Oakmont — Evidence bundle (logs, configs, vendor attestations): deliver to Redwood by 2026-12-22
- Redwood — Evidence intake & verification pass: complete by 2026-12-29
- Target commercial close / signature: 2026-12-31 (dependent on legal redlines + SOC 2 acceptance)

Dependencies & risks:
- Need temporary S3-read-only access to support logs (we'll share scope + temporary credentials checklist) — dependency on Oakmont security team.
- Legal: we expect review of standard MSA + DPA; if legal redlines are extensive, they may shift the close date.
- If IT can complete questionnaire earlier (week of Dec 6), we can accelerate evidence intake by ~1 week.

Attachments: MAP_draft_OAK-4821.pdf (high-level milestones & owners), Oakmont_SOC2_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (initial form).

Next actions (proposed):
1) Laura: confirm IT availability windows for evidence collection (suggested: Dec 6–10 or Dec 13–17)
2) Steve: confirm decision-maker timeline for signature (goal: end of year)
3) Marissa/Jordan: align on evidence intake process and who from Redwood will be the intake owner (I recommend Marissa as CS intake lead; Jordan will support technical validation)

If that all looks good, I'll schedule a 30-minute follow-up for Nov 29 to kick off the security track and hand off the questionnaire.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
(attachment: MAP_draft_OAK-4821.pdf)
(attachment: Oakmont_SOC2_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx)

Ben — thanks for the clear recap and the draft MAP. A few quick notes from our side after the internal sync: 

- We can target the Dec 6–10 window for IT to work on the questionnaire; that lines up with their maintenance window.
- Evidence collection will be stretched because we need time to pull archived logs and third-party attestations; we think Dec 22 is doable but tight. If we can get the questionnaire back to you by Dec 8, that helps.
- One ask: can Redwood provide an "evidence intake checklist" (concrete filenames, log ranges, acceptable formats) to reduce back-and-forth?

We'll plan on the Nov 29 kickoff — can you propose a time (we're PST). Attaching Oakmont_IT_Schedule.pdf with the windows we discussed.

Laura Gibbs
Head of Security Programs, Oakmont Financial
(attachment: Oakmont_IT_Schedule.pdf)

Subject: Re: Oakmont MAP: security intake & evidence sprint (draft) — owners + intake plan

Thanks — looping in the CS + Solutions owners and an intake plan.

Proposed owners (Redwood):
- Evidence intake owner / triage: Marissa Cole (CS) — will be your day-to-day contact for uploads and questions
- Technical evidence validation: Jordan Blake (Solutions Eng) — will validate logs, KV cache configs, and runtime settings
- Security lead (escalations/compliance): Rishi Malhotra (Security & Risk) — will review any open control questions and sign off on acceptance criteria

Draft intake process (short):
1) We will share an intake folder (Drive link below) and a single "manifest.csv" template that lists filenames + control mappings. Please have Oakmont upload artifacts there.
2) Marissa will triage uploads within 48 business hours and tag items for Jordan to validate.
3) Jordan will provide a verification summary (pass/partial/fail) within 5 business days of receipt.
4) Rishi will review any open items and advise on compensating controls or retest requirements.

Updated milestone dates (proposal based on your IT window):
- Redwood: Share evidence intake template & Drive folder (today) — complete
- Oakmont: Questionnaire answers due 2026-12-08 (owner: Oakmont IT)
- Oakmont: First evidence upload due 2026-12-16 (owner: Oakmont IT)
- Redwood: Validation pass 2026-12-23
- Commercial close: 2026-12-31 (still target; contingent on validation)

Attachments from Redwood: Redwood_Evidence_Template_v1.docx (manifest + example file names).

Drive link (intake folder): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD3fOakmontMAP
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/3412

If those owners/SLAs look good I'll schedule the Nov 29 30-min kickoff at 10:00 AM PST and send calendar invites.

—Marissa
